dedupe_keys.name: american rivers database and map of us dams removed since 1912

description: American Rivers keeps a running inventory of dam removal projects in the United States since 1912, shown on an online map and published as a database. The page explains that the inventory includes projects led by American Rivers and by others, and links a compiled summary document and the raw dataset on Figshare (ARDamRemovalList, March 2026 release). Information from the database is free to use by anyone provided the stated citation is included (no other licence is stated), and users are invited to submit updates or missing projects. Caveats: the list is compiled from many sources and relies on reported projects, so attributes and completeness vary. It covers the United States and supports river restoration planning and analysis of removed, obsolete or unsafe dams, including the condition and ageing of small water infrastructure; there are no related records in the catalogue for this dataset yet.
